items.title: CDW Stock Earnings Beat Has The Bull Case Changed?

items.title: CDW Just Raised Its Dividend 8%. Is This Tech Stock a Hidden Gem?
items.summary: After years of raises so small they barely registered, CDW just delivered a bigger check, but rising debt and shrinking margins complicate the story. Retirees weighing a spot on their dividend list should look past the headline number.

items.title: Is CDW (CDW) Fully Valued After Strong Results, Higher Guidance, And The Lovelytics Deal?
items.summary: CDW (CDW) just delivered a busier quarter than usual. Fresh third quarter results, a higher full year earnings outlook, a larger dividend, and the Lovelytics acquisition all landed at once. Investors have reacted quickly to the news, with the 1 day share price return of 12.67% and 30 day share price return of 24.38% pushing CDW to US$168.75.
